name: Valentine Memories ~Mai Furu Yuki no Naka de~
original_name: Valentine Memories ～舞い降る雪の中で～
source:
Lively main heroine studies diligently in order to enter the same school as her beloved calm brother. Finally she succeeds, and it's time for rest on Valentine's day.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
